activity.role: Early Honma governor tradition of Sado
activity.notes: Later Honma genealogical tradition associates Honma Yoshihisa with the origins of Honma rule on Sado, but modern historical summaries place the securely documented Honma entry into Sado's shugo-deputy structure after the Jōkyū War and the documentary record becomes firm only in the thirteenth century. ATLAS therefore preserves only a c.1185 representative tradition point with uncertain/disputed status and does not fabricate a continuous rule interval or treat the Honma clan itself as a state.

sources.title: 本間氏 — 世界大百科事典 via Kotobank
sources.citation_text: The encyclopedia treats the Honma as local warriors of Sado and places their documented Sado shugo-deputy position in the Kamakura period, with secure evidence emerging in the thirteenth century.

sources.title: 佐渡市歴史的風致維持向上計画 — Sado City
sources.citation_text: Sado City's historical plan states that the Honma entered Sado as deputies of the shugo after the Jōkyū War and subsequently expanded their control across the island.
